Definition: from the base of G5205; wet (as if with rain), i.e. (by implication) sappy (fresh):--green.
BiblicalUsage: hygrós is the word for green, moist, fresh. In Luke 23:31, the text says "For if they do these things in a green tree."
TheologicalSignificance: I take hygrós as it stands: green, moist, fresh.
RelatedEvents: The Crucifixion; Simon of Cyrene Carries Jesus' Cross
